findings.problem: The second P1 prompt reads '0을 포함한 서로 다른 기호 u개로 길이 v인 문자열을 만듭니다. 첫 기호만 0을 금지할 때…'. It never says that symbols may repeat. In Korean 경우의 수 problems, '서로 다른 … 로 만든다' without '중복을 허락하여' normally means no repetition, i.e. a permutation. The answer key (u−1)·u^{v−1} only holds when repetition is allowed. Read the default way, the correct count is (u−1)·(u−1)P(v−1), and it is 0 whenever v>u. For example, u=2 and v=13 cannot be built without repetition, yet the key gives 1·2^{12}. The first P1 item does say '중복 허용하여'. Dropping that phrase in the second item makes the change look deliberate, so a student who reads the convention correctly is graded wrong in every one of the 144 variants. The three formulas are distinct for all (u,v), u=2 included, so the only problem is that the prompt does not fix the counting model.
findings.fix: Add the condition to the prompt: '0을 포함한 서로 다른 기호 u개를 중복을 허용하여 사용해 길이 v인 문자열을 만듭니다. 첫 기호만 0을 금지할 때…'. No change to the key or the distractors is needed.

verified_fixes: groupReviewMath (retrieval.js:7,92): the regex ([_^])([+-]?\d{2,}) applies only inside $…$. It wraps multi-digit sub/superscripts in braces, e.g. \log_{12}(12^{11}), x^{24}, (1/u)^{13}, \int_{12}^{…}. It skips anything already braced (^{…}). It does not misfire on ^2+12x or ^2−144, because the sign must come right after ^ and at least two digits must follow. It runs after the choice shuffle, on both the prompt and the options.
A3 second: log_b(u²)=2 with b>1 gives b²=u², so b=u. The key u is correct for all u in 2..13. The 15-digit typing burden is gone.
A5 first: f=c·2^x and f(v)=u give f(v+1)=2u. The key and reason are correct, and the answer is at most 26.

P1 first: u^{v}, with distractors u^{v−1} and u^{v+1}. The option strings and their values are distinct for all (u,v), u=2 and v=2 included. P1 second's formulas (u−1)·u^{v−1}, u^{v} and (u−1)^{v} are also distinct, u=2 included; its prompt wording is the separate finding above.
